savedProposed: Saved. The price changes went to the rikma for approval
notFound: This product isn't in this rikma
archived: This product is archived and can't be edited
leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

gallery.title: Pictures ({{count}}/12)
gallery.hint: The first picture is the cover
gallery.badType: Only pictures can be uploaded (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF)
gallery.failed: The picture wasn't uploaded. Try again.
gallery.empty: No pictures yet. Buyers see the cover first.

options.title: Options
options.hint: Size or colour, for example. Every combination becomes a variant with its own price and stock.
options.name: Option name
options.reuse: An option the rikma already has
options.retired: {{count}} variants with no combination left will be hidden from the shop. They are not deleted.
options.retiredOne: 1 variant with no combination left will be hidden from the shop. It is not deleted.

err.axisDuplicate: Two options have the same name
err.axisNoValues: Every option needs at least one value

variants.title: Variants
variants.pickHint: With none chosen, the variant shows the product's pictures
variants.noGallery: Add pictures to the product first
variants.keepNote: A variant that has sold is never deleted: it is hidden, and its past orders stay intact.
variants.empty: No variants: the product sells as a single item. Add an option to create variants.

err.skuTaken: Another product of the rikma uses this SKU
err.fix: Some fields need fixing before saving
err.openProposal: A change to this product is already waiting for the rikma. Answer it first.
err.notReady: Proposing variant prices isn't available yet. Everything else was saved.
err.bomFix: Some recipe lines need fixing: each needs a name and valid numbers.
err.bomEmpty: A product priced by its cost needs at least one line in its recipe.
err.bomNotReady: Proposing a recipe change is not available yet. Your other changes were saved.

pending.title: Waiting for the rikma
pending.buyers: Until it's approved, buyers see the current price.
pending.silence: If nobody responds, it is approved {{when}}
pending.name: New name: {{name}}
pending.bomReleaseMine: Keep the work, not on me
pending.bomReleased: The assignment was removed. The new version went to your partners

propose.title: Goes to the rikma for approval
propose.hint: A price is a term of the product, so changing it, or adding a variant, goes to the partners. Stock, pictures and the rest save right away.
propose.whyPlaceholder: e.g. the material got more expensive
propose.personal: This is a personal product, so everything saves right away.
propose.alone: The rikma has no other partners, so everything saves right away.

stock.title: Price and stock
stock.basePriceHint: A variant without its own price sells at this one
stock.lowHint: How many units left before you reorder? Applies to each variant separately.
stock.lowNotSaved: The low-stock mark isn't stored yet

details.title: Product details
details.name: Name

kindHint.total: One price for every unit sold.
kindHint.monthly: The price is charged every month.
kindHint.yearly: The price is charged every year.
kindHint.unlimited: No stock — sell as many as you like.

details.periodHint: Optional. The period the subscription is open for sale.

create.title: New product
create.subtitle: Simple — or complex, a recipe of missions and resources. Saving opens the full editor: pictures, variants and stock.

remove.title: Remove from the shop
remove.hint: The product leaves the shop, the catalog and the products list. Sales, orders and profit splits already made on it stay in the history — nothing is deleted.
remove.confirm: Remove "{{name}}" from the shop? Its sales stay in the history.
remove.failed: We couldn't remove the product. Please try again.
remove.rikma: This product belongs to the rikma, so removing it is a proposal to the partners: they can approve, discuss or counter, and silence until the rikma's response time approves it.
remove.alone: You're the only member of the rikma — the removal applies at once.
remove.open: There is already an open proposal on this product (removal or change). You can respond to it in the vote.
remove.archived: This product was removed from the shop. It is kept in the rikma's archive with all its sales.

form.title: New product
form.intro: Three short steps and you can save. More pictures, variants and stock can be added now or later.
form.step1Sub: A name, a few words and a main picture
form.namePh: For example: a pottery workshop for two
form.step2Sub: By what it really costs to make, or one number
form.byCostSub: The missions and resources the product needs
form.costHint: The price is exactly the sum of its parts, with nothing added. Every new mission or resource opens in the rikma.
form.noLines: No missions or resources added yet
form.step3Sub: Once or as a subscription, and how many units there are
form.groupLabel: Also offer this product to a group buying together
form.groupHint: Then you can set, for each mission and resource, whether its cost is shared among the participants.
form.noteVote: The product goes to the partners for approval, and silence until the rikma's response time ends is consent.
form.noteSolo: In a rikma of one, the product is saved at once.
form.editIntro: Change anything here. Stock, pictures and location save at once. Price and product terms go to your partners.
form.coverHint: The first picture in the gallery is the cover.
form.pricingLocked: How the price is set was decided when the product was created.
form.bomTitle: What the product is made of
form.marginNote: The stored price includes a {{pct}}% addition. It stays until someone changes the price.
form.quoteLocked: In a rikma with partners, how the price is set does not change here.
form.stockInVariants: Stock is counted for each variant.
form.fixedAtCreate: Set when the product was created
form.stagedFailed: The product was created, but its pictures or variants were not saved. You can finish them here.
form.variantsCurrency: A variant price is written in the rikma's currency ({{currency}}). Switch the currency above, or leave the variant at the product price.
form.bomHintPartners: A change to the recipe goes to your partners, like a price. If you picked an owner, they must approve explicitly in the same vote: their silence is not consent, and they can keep the work without it being theirs.
form.bomHintAlone: Nobody else has to approve, so a change to the recipe saves at once. A new mission or resource opens in the rikma.
form.bomRemoveHint: Removing detaches the line from the product. The mission or resource itself stays in the rikma.
form.bomPriceFollows: The price follows the recipe. You can also type a different one.
form.bomDealHint: This product was made from a customer's request. A change that adds to the cost also waits for their signature, and their silence is not consent.
form.bomUnread: The recipe could not be read, so it cannot be changed right now.
